explanation: The statement says that if t < 1 and d t ≤ b(1+t²), with 0 ≤ b, 0 < d and 2b < d, then t ≤ 2b/(d+√(d²−4b²)). That is the smaller root of a specific quadratic, written in a rationalized form. I searched Mathlib/Algebra/QuadraticDiscriminant.lean, which has quadratic_eq_zero_iff, discrim_le_zero and related lemmas. None of them gives an inequality bound by the small root in this form. Deriving it from them would need the root identity, the factorization argument and several side facts, so it is not a one- or two-line special case.
